_howToEdit: Change any text below. Keep the double quotes and commas. {her} and {him} get replaced with the names. Photos go in the photos folder, songs go in the music folder.

intro.hint: Tap the heart to open it

home.headline: I'm sorry. Sit with me for a while?
home.subtext: I made you this little place. There's a letter, our memories, and our songs. Take your time.

letter.skipHint: Tap the letter to show it all
paragraphs: I've started this letter more times than I can count, because I wanted to get it right. You deserve more than a quick sorry over text, so here it is, written properly.
I know I hurt you, and I'm not going to make excuses. You had every right to be upset. I've thought about it a lot, and I understand now how it felt from your side. I'm truly sorry.
These past few days have felt so quiet. I didn't realise how much of my day is built around you until it wasn't.
I don't just want to say sorry. I want to do better. I want to listen more, notice the little things, and never make you feel like you're anything less than my favourite person. Because you are.
So I made you this little corner of the internet. It's not much, but every part of it is for you, and I mean every word.
letter.postscript: P.S. There's a question for you just below. Answer honestly. (But also, please say yes.)

forgive.question: So... do you forgive me?
forgive.yesMessage: Thank you for giving me another chance. I love you, more than I'm good at saying.

items.caption: Where it all started
items.message: I still remember how nervous I was this day. Best decision I ever made.

items.caption: That smile
items.message: This is the smile I'd do anything to see again. Please let me earn it back.

items.caption: Our silly day
items.message: We laughed so much my stomach hurt. I miss that. I miss us.

items.caption: Just us
items.message: Nothing special happened this day, and it was still one of my favourites, because you were there.

items.caption: Many more to come
items.message: Here's to a hundred more photos like this. I promise.
